question: For a single-GBP home-service contractor (roofing-primary) in North Carolina in 2024-2026, what off-page / 'prominence-pillar' SEO (local citations + NAP consistency, local-relevant & niche links, digital PR, branded mentions) actually moves LOCAL rankings (Google map pack + organic)? Where is the white-hat vs penalty line (Google link-spam policy + SpamBrain)? Which vendors/tools should an agency use, with REAL current pricing and an explicit AVOID list? And how should off-page budget be tiered by market competition, with worked monthly numbers for Raleigh, Charlotte, Rocky Mount, Greenville NC, and Lumberton NC?
subQuestions: Which off-page PROMINENCE signals actually move LOCAL rankings (map pack + organic) for home-service contractors, ranked by leverage, separating Google's own statements (Search Central 'relevance/distance/prominence' local-ranking doc, Mueller) from SEO-community lore — covering local citations/NAP consistency, local-relevant & niche-relevant links, local digital PR, and branded search/brand mentions?

Where is the white-hat vs penalty line: per Google's link-spam policy and SpamBrain, what link patterns get algorithmically DEVALUED vs what triggers a MANUAL ACTION, and what are safe anchor-text distributions and link-velocity profiles for a local contractor? What is the explicit AVOID list (PBNs, link farms, bulk/spam directories, paid footer/sitewide links, exact-match-anchor over-optimization, Fiverr link blasts)?

What is the off-page vendor/tool matrix with REAL current (2024-2026) pricing: citation building & management (BrightLocal, Whitespark, Moz Local, Yext, Loganix), local link-building / digital-PR services (incl. contractor-niche options), review-generation tools (GatherUp, NiceJob, Grade.us, Birdeye, etc.), and rank/competitor-data tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz Pro, Local Falcon, DataForSEO) — for each: what it does, pricing tiers, white-hat reputation (independent vs marketing), and DIY-vs-outsource fit?

What is a repeatable METHOD to size an off-page budget for any market from the competitor backlink/citation gap + local search difficulty, and what are the resulting tiered (small / mid / aggressive) one-time citation-setup and monthly link/PR budget ranges, broken down by category (citations, links, PR, tools)?

For Raleigh NC (primary, real GBP), Charlotte NC (large/competitive), and Rocky Mount / Greenville / Lumberton NC (smaller eastern): what is the local SEO competition level, rough incumbent citation/backlink strength, recommended monthly off-page budget + tactic mix, and realistic timeline-to-result — flagging where exact competitor data requires a paid Ahrefs/Semrush/Moz pull?

What is the correct off-page SEQUENCE/playbook for a local contractor — foundation (citations + NAP consistency) first, then local-relevant links + digital PR, then maintenance cadence — and what is the sensible DIY-vs-vendor split for an agency running this at scale?
How does off-page SEO spend package into a productized local-SEO offer (base retainer + SEO upsell) and what is the agency margin math — pass-through cost vs marked-up retainer vs bundled?

Independent local ranking-factor studies (BrightLocal Local Search Ranking Factors / Whitespark / Sterling Sky) on citation + link weight for map pack vs organic
NAP consistency & citation impact on local rankings — current 2024-2026 evidence vs diminishing-returns view
Local-relevant & niche-relevant link leverage (geo + topical relevance beats raw DA)
Local digital PR tactics (HARO/Connectively/Featured, local news, sponsorships, scholarships caveat) for contractors
Branded search volume + brand/unstructured mentions as a prominence signal
Google link-spam policy actual text (link schemes; what counts as a violation)
SpamBrain + link devaluation (ignored/neutralized) vs manual action (penalty) — the distinction
Safe anchor-text distribution (branded/naked/generic heavy; exact-match light) + link-velocity guidance
AVOID list: PBNs, link farms, bulk spam directories, paid footer/sitewide links, exact-match over-optimization, cheap Fiverr/marketplace link blasts
BrightLocal pricing + what it does (citation builder + Local rank tracker + audits)
Whitespark pricing (Local Citation Finder, citation building service, Local Rank Tracker)
Moz Local pricing + Moz Pro pricing
Yext pricing (and the lease-not-own caveat)
Loganix / other done-for-you citation + link build service pricing
Local link-building / digital-PR service pricing (per-link ranges, monthly retainers, contractor niche)
Review-generation tool pricing (GatherUp, NiceJob, Grade.us/ReviewShake, Birdeye, Podium)
Rank + competitor-data tool pricing (Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz Pro, Local Falcon, DataForSEO) and which gives backlink/citation gap data
Budget-sizing method: competitor citation + backlink gap analysis -> spend
Tiered budget ranges (one-time citation setup + monthly links/PR) by category
Raleigh NC local SEO competition + incumbent strength + budget + timeline
Charlotte NC local SEO competition + incumbent strength + budget + timeline
Rocky Mount / Greenville / Lumberton NC competition + budget + timeline
Off-page sequence/playbook (foundation -> links/PR -> maintenance) + DIY-vs-vendor split
Off-page offer packaging + agency margin math
stopCondition: Stop when rounds stop surfacing NOVEL sourced claims across the leverage-ranking, penalty-line, vendor-pricing, and per-market sub-questions. Required source discipline: every off-page leverage claim and every penalty-line claim carries at least one PRIMARY or independent-study source (Google Search Central / link-spam policy / BrightLocal-Whitespark-Sterling-Sky study), explicitly separated from vendor marketing; every vendor-pricing claim carries a vendor pricing-page or recent independent-review source with the price as of 2024-2026; per-market competition claims are flagged PROVISIONAL where sharpening them would require a paid Ahrefs/Semrush/Moz competitor-data pull (which is out of scope / not to be purchased).
notes: userConfirmedTier:true only authorizes the LITE tier (lite needs no escalation per skill gate). Do NOT escalate to standard/max. Do NOT purchase paid competitor-data API pulls. Deliver budget MODEL + public-data estimates; flag where a paid pull sharpens per-market numbers.
